"""Can today's close be recovered from persisted keys well enough to grade a
TIGHTER Camarilla multiplier offline? close_est = vwap * (1 + pct_from_vwap/100)
(technical.py:374, :382, both rounded). Reproduction test (the S6-B3290b
precondition): above_cam_r4 == (close_est > cam_r4) on long fires and
below_cam_s4 == (close_est < cam_s4) on short fires, every fire. Also the
smallest margin |close_est - level| seen, against the rounding error bound.
Read-only."""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(r"C:\Users\jeetm\Github\stock-picks-app")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts"))
import build_strategy_status as bss  # noqa: E402

tl = pd.read_csv(ROOT / "output_r5_merged_1_7" / "trade_log.csv", low_memory=False,
                 usecols=["strategy", "ticker", "entry_date", "direction", "signals_at_entry"])
cam = tl[tl["strategy"] == "camarilla_r4_breakout"].drop_duplicates(["ticker", "entry_date"])
have = rep = miss = 0
worst = []
for d, raw in zip(cam["direction"], cam["signals_at_entry"]):
    s = bss._parse_signals(raw)
    try:
        v, p = float(s["vwap"]), float(s["pct_from_vwap"])
        r4, s4 = float(s["cam_r4"]), float(s["cam_s4"])
    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
        miss += 1
        continue
    have += 1
    c = v * (1 + p / 100)
    if d == "long":
        ok = bool(s.get("above_cam_r4")) == (c > r4)
        worst.append(abs(c - r4) / r4)
    else:
        ok = bool(s.get("below_cam_s4")) == (c < s4)
        worst.append(abs(c - s4) / s4)
    rep += ok
print(f"fires {len(cam)}; vwap + pct_from_vwap present on {have}; missing {miss}")
print(f"gate leg reproduced by close_est: {rep} of {have}")
worst.sort()
print("smallest relative margins |close_est - level| / level:", [round(x, 6) for x in worst[:5]])
print("rounding bound on close_est (relative): about 5e-6 (pct_from_vwap to 3 dp of a percent)")
